content.primary_citation: Dhar A, Sisk TR, Robustelli P. Ensemble Docking for Intrinsically Disordered Proteins. J Chem Inf Model. 2025;65(13):6847-6860.
content.validation_notes: Ligands Fasudil and Ligand-47 are validated α-Synuclein binders. Literature (PMC12264940, PMC9569888) confirms the C-terminal region (residues 125-136) as the primary binding site. Ligand-47 (4-methyl-N-(biphenyl-4-yl)benzamide) is identified as a high-affinity binder in ensemble docking studies. Protocol specifies PED00024_e001 ensemble with 575 conformations, optimized for 3 clusters. Confidence is extremely high due to direct experimental and computational validation in the cited 2025 study.
